findings: 1.6.1 trains `SingleDrugRandomForest` once per drug with `random_state` unset (global numpy stream); v2 pins `random_state` in the predictor and builds one forest per drug from it. With `random_state` equal to the integer the global stream is seeded with before each drug, the per-drug forests are identical (feature importances and predictions exact).

Same scaler deviation as `SingleDrugElasticNet`: 1.6.1 standardizes with the training samples of the drug, v2 with all training samples (plan 4.4). With a shared sample set the features agree to float32 precision.

Defaults: 1.6.1 first grid point n_estimators=100, max_samples=0.2, max_depth=5 (grid 5/10/30); v2 declares n_estimators=100, max_samples=0.2, max_depth=15. Only max_depth differs. B5 should decide whether to match.
The v2 preset uses the whole gene view (`scaledGeneExpression` without `gene_list`) while 1.6.1 selects `landmark_genes`. Compared on a pre-selected matrix; the list wiring belongs to B5.
